text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the
shopping
district...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hmmm...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Shhh! Quiet! I'm seriously worried right
now!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Hehehehe. I wonder if you'll guess right.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Which soda did I shake?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Hehe... It's a very dangerous game. Choose the wrong bottle and it'll go pshhh...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: PSHAAA!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
It'll make a splash like a water park.
Hehe. ♪
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Apparently, they're playing a game
where they
have to guess which one of
the sodas has been
shaken.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You only get one chance to decide your
fate.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...Which means, failure is not an option.
Not at
all.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: She sounds quite serious, but...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: (...She rather seems to be having fun.)

text_block_list.text:
Will you choose well and quench your
thirst? Or
will you guess wrong and be
doused in a soda
shower?
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: So which is it, King? Time to choose!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd go with the one on the
right.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
I'm not going to fall for that, Sky! I know
you're
trying to trick me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ugh... Which one should I choose?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Сэйун Скай said the one on the right is safe.

text_block_list.text:
Ha! That's right! So far, we've only heard
from
Sky!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're asking me?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I can see the panic on your
face,
Спешл Уик!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Now, answer! Which bottle did you guys
shake?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ummm... Well... Uh... ummm!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Whistle, whistle. ♪
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Nice one, Spe. Assert your right to
remain
silent!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Grrrr! So it's like that, is it? If that's the
case, I'm
not leaving your side until you
fess up!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Heh, I wonder which of you will break
first.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text: Hnnngh!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Whistle, whistle. ♪
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Spe, you're getting pretty good at
whistling.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
You're right. Sometimes, you just have to
dive in!
Let's do this!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Pshaaaa!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, bingo!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just as expected, King. You
make the
most delicious choices.
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Ugh! I don't find anything about this
"delicious"!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Uh-oh, looks like I've incurred the king's
wrath!
Time to skedaddle!
text_block_list.name: Сэйун Скай

text_block_list.text:
Graaah! Get back here, Sky! It's your
turn next!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало and Спешл Уик run off
after Seiun
Sky.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I'm just glad they're having fun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Looks like they're still at it. So long as
they're
having fun, I see no problem.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
